title: Minecraft Bone Meal Farm Tutorial - Self Sustaining - 5000 P/H!
description:
Hello Guys TheySix Is here with a New Minecraft Tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Super Efficient and simple Bone Meal Farm Based On Moss Blocks that is self-sustaining! In Minecraft

📚This Bonemeal Farm is so fast and can produce +4500 -~ 5000 Bonemeals Per Hour!
📚This bonemeal farm is self-sustaining!
📚It's so easy to build you can build this farm only in 30 - 40 minutes!
📚Unfortunately because of some game mechanics, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
